name: opcua
label: OPC UA (Industrial)
description: Industrial automation data standard — used by every IIoT platform (Siemens, Rockwell, ABB)

table_notes.opcua_server: Registry of OPC UA server instances; each row represents one server endpoint with its connection state and identity.
table_notes.opcua_node: OPC UA address-space node (variable, object, method, or type); forms a self-referential hierarchy via parent_id.
table_notes.opcua_data_value: Time-series store for node values; one row per sampled value with typed columns to avoid JSONB overhead for common types.
table_notes.opcua_alarm: Process alarm and event log sourced from OPC UA Alarms & Conditions (A&C); tracks lifecycle from trigger to acknowledgement.
table_notes.opcua_method_call: Audit log of OPC UA Method Service calls; preserves input/output argument payloads and the OPC UA status result.

opcua_server.name: id
opcua_server.description: Surrogate primary key for the server record

opcua_server.name: application_uri
opcua_server.description: OPC UA ApplicationUri — globally unique URI identifying this server application instance

opcua_server.name: product_name
opcua_server.description: Human-readable product name reported by the server in its ApplicationDescription

opcua_server.name: manufacturer
opcua_server.description: Vendor or manufacturer name as reported in the server ApplicationDescription

opcua_server.name: software_version
opcua_server.description: Server software version string (e.g. 1.4.3) for compatibility tracking

opcua_server.name: endpoint_url
opcua_server.description: OPC UA endpoint URL (opc.tcp://host:port/path) used to establish sessions

opcua_server.name: is_online
opcua_server.description: Whether the server was reachable at last health check; updated by the polling service

opcua_server.name: last_connected_at
opcua_server.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful OPC UA session establishment

opcua_node.name: id
opcua_node.description: Surrogate primary key for the node record

opcua_node.name: server_id
opcua_node.description: OPC UA server that owns this node; references opcua_server.id

opcua_node.name: node_id
opcua_node.description: OPC UA NodeId string (e.g. ns=2;s=Pump1.Speed) — unique within a server

opcua_node.name: browse_name
opcua_node.description: OPC UA BrowseName (namespace:name) used for programmatic node traversal

opcua_node.name: display_name
opcua_node.description: Localised human-readable name shown in client UIs and HMI screens

opcua_node.name: node_class
opcua_node.description: OPC UA NodeClass: Variable, Object, Method, ObjectType, VariableType, ReferenceType, DataType, or View

opcua_node.name: data_type
opcua_node.description: OPC UA DataType NodeId or name (e.g. Double, Int32, String) for Variable-class nodes

opcua_node.name: access_level
opcua_node.description: OPC UA AccessLevel bitmask: bit0=CurrentRead, bit1=CurrentWrite, bit2=HistoryRead, bit3=HistoryWrite

opcua_node.name: parent_id
opcua_node.description: Parent node in the address-space hierarchy; self-referential FK to opcua_node.id (NULL for root objects)

opcua_node.name: description
opcua_node.description: OPC UA Description attribute — free-text documentation supplied by the server for this node

opcua_data_value.name: id
opcua_data_value.description: Auto-incrementing surrogate key for the data value row

opcua_data_value.name: node_id
opcua_data_value.description: Node whose value was sampled; references opcua_node.id

opcua_data_value.name: value_boolean
opcua_data_value.description: Sampled value for Boolean-typed nodes (OPC UA DataType Boolean)

opcua_data_value.name: value_int
opcua_data_value.description: Sampled value for integer-typed nodes (Int16/Int32/Int64/UInt*); stores widest possible integer

opcua_data_value.name: value_float
opcua_data_value.description: Sampled value for floating-point nodes (Float/Double OPC UA types)

opcua_data_value.name: value_string
opcua_data_value.description: Sampled value for String/ByteString/LocalizedText nodes, or fallback for other types

opcua_data_value.name: source_timestamp
opcua_data_value.description: OPC UA SourceTimestamp — when the value was produced at the data source (PLC/sensor)

opcua_data_value.name: server_timestamp
opcua_data_value.description: OPC UA ServerTimestamp — when the server received or recorded the value

opcua_data_value.name: status_code
opcua_data_value.description: OPC UA StatusCode (32-bit); 0x00000000 = Good; non-zero indicates quality/uncertainty issues

opcua_alarm.name: id
opcua_alarm.description: Surrogate primary key for the alarm/event record

opcua_alarm.name: server_id
opcua_alarm.description: Server that generated this alarm; references opcua_server.id

opcua_alarm.name: node_id
opcua_alarm.description: Address-space node that is the source of the alarm condition; references opcua_node.id

opcua_alarm.name: event_type
opcua_alarm.description: OPC UA EventType NodeId or name (e.g. ExclusiveLimitAlarmType, DiscreteAlarmType)

opcua_alarm.name: severity
opcua_alarm.description: OPC UA severity value 1–1000; 1=Low, 500=Medium, 1000=High per OPC UA Part 9

opcua_alarm.name: message
opcua_alarm.description: OPC UA Event Message LocalizedText — human-readable description of the alarm condition

opcua_alarm.name: active_state
opcua_alarm.description: Whether the alarm condition is currently active (True) or returned to normal (False)

opcua_alarm.name: triggered_at
opcua_alarm.description: Timestamp when the alarm condition first became active (OPC UA ActiveState.TransitionTime)

opcua_alarm.name: acknowledged_at
opcua_alarm.description: Timestamp when an operator acknowledged the alarm; NULL if not yet acknowledged

opcua_method_call.name: id
opcua_method_call.description: Auto-incrementing surrogate key for the method call record

opcua_method_call.name: node_id
opcua_method_call.description: Node representing the OPC UA Method that was invoked; references opcua_node.id

opcua_method_call.name: method_name
opcua_method_call.description: Human-readable method name (display name of the Method node) for quick identification

opcua_method_call.name: input_args
opcua_method_call.description: Input argument values passed to the method; structure: [{"name": str, "type": str, "value": any}]

opcua_method_call.name: output_args
opcua_method_call.description: Output argument values returned by the method; structure: [{"name": str, "type": str, "value": any}]

opcua_method_call.name: status_code
opcua_method_call.description: OPC UA StatusCode of the Call result; 0x00000000 = Good, non-zero encodes error class and sub-code

opcua_method_call.name: called_at
opcua_method_call.description: Timestamp when this method call was recorded; defaults to server wall-clock time at insert

short_description: Industrial automation data standard — used by every IIoT platform (Siemens, Rockwell, ABB)
long_description: OPC UA (Unified Architecture) is the IEC 62541 standard for industrial automation data exchange, combining platform-independent data modeling with built-in security. The schema covers OPC UA server registration, node address space (variables, objects, methods), real-time data values, process alarms, and method call logging.
when_to_use: Use for Industrial IoT platforms, SCADA/DCS system integrations, manufacturing execution systems (MES), or any Industry 4.0 application. OPC UA is implemented in virtually all modern industrial equipment from Siemens, Rockwell, ABB, Beckhoff, and Bosch. Required for Industry 4.0 compliance in EU's IACS cybersecurity framework (IEC 62443) and German Industrie 4.0 reference architecture (RAMI 4.0).
